iteration.area: Turn-scoped Single completion, generic Team contracts, and exact review-to-task repair
changes: Single completion status ignores old stale receipts when judging an unrelated current plain-answer turn.
The fullstack Web template no longer imposes blog-specific response fields, search fields, pagination constants, or a fixed test command; integrator paths remain bounded.
Review findings can bind target_task_id and target_artifact_id; host review snapshots retain task_id and attempt_id.
Review repair resolves only a unique exact artifact/task/attempt owner; ambiguous legacy findings fail closed. Added parser and routing regression test source.

validation.cargo_or_tests: not run; deferred for the single final verification pass

remaining: Audit duplicated ContractSubagentRunner and ProfileSubagentRunner execution assembly while preserving their tool permissions, bounded budgets, persistence, and request telemetry.
Continue source-level review of WorkerRuntime repair/recovery and exact review freshness.
After implementation stabilizes, perform the single resource-policy-compliant final Rust validation; measure Team versus Single only on matched live tasks and do not claim an unmeasured advantage.
